# Acorns Nest

> Daycare management software for licensed childcare centres in Canada. Directors run the centre from a web dashboard; teachers, kitchen staff and parents use the iOS and Android app. Built in Halifax, Nova Scotia by Acorns Nest Inc.

## About

- Company: Acorns Nest Inc.
- Location: 5651 Ogilvie Street, Unit 411, Halifax, Nova Scotia B3H 1B9, Canada
- Founded by: Vishnu Priyan Mahendran, Vignesh Moorthy
- Launched: September 2026
- Country served: Canada
- Contact: support@acornsnest.com

## What Acorns Nest does

Acorns Nest is a daycare management platform for licensed childcare centres. It covers:

- Attendance and check-in / check-out, with Bulk Log and Mid-day Exit and Return
- Nap timers (one child or whole room, more than one nap per day)
- Meal intake in 25% steps, infant milk in ounces
- Weekly menu planner — breakfast, lunch, evening snack, saved reusable weeks
- Parent communication: public classroom and centre feeds, private per-family notes
- Attendance reports by centre, classroom and child, with CSV export
- Staff timesheets with director approval
- Outing Mode for field trips, with real-time parent notification
- AI Insights: director-facing briefings generated from the day's logs

Directors use a web dashboard at acornsnest.com. Teachers, kitchen staff and parents use the iOS and Android apps.

## Who it is for

Licensed childcare centres in Canada and the people who work in them: directors, lead and assistant early childhood educators (ECEs), substitutes, kitchen staff, and the parents and guardians of enrolled children.

## How parents and staff get access

There is no public sign-up. Centres invite each parent or staff member by email with a code. They accept the invite at acornsnest.com/accept-invite, install the app, and sign in.

## Privacy

Children do not have accounts. Acorns Nest does not sell personal information and does not use it for advertising. Data is processed on the centre's instructions. See https://acornsnest.com/privacy for the full policy.
